description: List or search the group directory. Served by the Authority One AppView indexer. Only public groups are surfaced to anonymous/non-member requesters; unlisted and private groups appear only to an effective member (so membership-scoped 'my groups' search works). Reverse-chronological, cursor-paginated.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match over the group name. Omit to list the directory.

member.description: Optional filter: only groups this DID is an effective member of.
